formal_statement: ∃ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin 7 → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ (w : Fin 7) (x : Fin 7 → Bool), ((Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin 7 => x p = false)).card = 4 ∨ (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin 7 => x p = false)).card = 5) → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ (({0, 1, 3} : Finset (Fin 7)).image (fun u => u + w)), x v = true)) ∧ gates.length ≤ 13
plain_statement: Take the 7 points 0..6 and the 7 lines {w, w + 1, w + 3} (mod 7). Some list of at most 13 gates, each an AND or OR reading at most two wires, has for each line a wire equal to the OR of the line's three points on every input with exactly 4 or exactly 5 false points.
title: Search: an AND/OR list of fan-in two with at most 13 gates right on the 7 line-ORs of the plane of order 2 at every input with exactly 4 or 5 false points
